about: The engine reads the moment from the Workbook's clock once per recalculation, so every NOW in one recalculation answers the same moment (SH-59, ADR-0124). The case's clock moves on a second at each read, so a second read in one recalculation would show in the count and in the Values. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' NowSourceReadTests.

cases.name: SH-59, ADR-0124: every NOW in one recalculation answers the one moment read for it
SH-59, ADR-0124: a recalculation of several passes (a spill laid out) still reads the clock once
SH-59, ADR-0124: moving the clock on reads it once, and the moment moves with it
